input: The first line of the input contains a single integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤2000$$$1 \le t \le 2000$$$) — the number of testcases.
The first line of each testcase contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and k$$$k$$$ (2≤n≤105$$$2 \le n \le 10^5$$$, 1≤k≤1015$$$1 \le k \le 10^{15}$$$).

It is guaranteed that the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 105$$$10^5$$$.
